prompt: 試算表から損益計算書(当期純利益)と貸借対照表(資産・負債・資本合計)を導出せよ。

given.map_note: OperatingExpenses is an aggregate trial-balance line with no single EA canonical counterpart: EA itemizes operating expenses into named accounts (RentExpense, UtilitiesExpense, SuppliesExpenses, MiscellaneousExpenses, ...) rather than exposing one blanket 'OperatingExpenses' account. Mapped to itself (identity) as a provisional placeholder pending an accounting-review decision on whether the eval harness should instead require itemization.

expected_output.format_note: Return a single JSON object with key "derived": a flat string→number map using dot-separated keys that mirror the nested income_statement/balance_sheet structure, e.g. {"income_statement.revenue": 8000, "income_statement.cogs": 5000, "income_statement.operating_expenses": 500, "income_statement.net_income": 2500, "balance_sheet.total_assets": 10000, "balance_sheet.total_liabilities": 1500, "balance_sheet.total_equity": 8500}.
